Earlier versions

The app keeps a snapshot of your notes every few minutes.

Move actions between notebooks

Send the actions assigned to one person from this notebook, and bring them into another one, without sharing any notes or pages. For example, ideas you jot down at home that you want in your work notebook.

Appearance

Typing

Team

The people and Claude projects you can assign actions to. Turn on Keep a feed for one and the app writes a file, in a folder you choose and share with them, listing their actions, so they can answer “done?”. You always confirm. A feed holds each action’s text, date, notes and status, not your notes.

From the team

If someone shared a folder with you, connect it here. Then you see what is assigned to you and the pages shared with you, and can send “done?” requests and suggestions back.

Set-up guide

Nothing to install: this is one web page. Each step ticks itself when it is done.

Install as an app

Help

RAID types

Choose the types this notebook uses, what you call them, and add your own or delete the ones you do not need (at least one stays). It is saved in this notebook’s file, so your work and home notebooks can differ. Switching one off hides its page, menus and shortcuts; the items you already have stay in your notes.

Notifications

Quick access toolbar (in notes)

A strip above the editor tabs that stays put whichever tab is open. The easy way: right-click any button or menu in the editor and choose Add to Quick Access Toolbar. Or tick them here and use the arrows to put them in order. It is saved in your notebook file.

Keyboard shortcuts

Press Change, then the keys you want. Keys without Ctrl or Alt (like N or /) only work when you are not typing; Ctrl or Alt combinations work anywhere. Saved in your notebook file, so they follow you between computers.

Replies

Nothing here changes your page until you accept it. Names come from the reply file and are not verified.

My Notebook

Compare this copy with your live site, and see what changed in each version.

Notebooks

Group your pages, like OneNote. Use ▲ ▼ (or drag a heading in the Notes list) to put the notebooks in the order you like. Each note lives in one notebook. Actions, risks, issues and decisions still roll up everywhere, and you can filter them by notebook. Deleting a notebook moves its pages to another one.

People

Anyone you assign actions to. Typing “@Sam” in an action adds Sam here by itself. Removing someone just unassigns their actions.

Categories

Group your items and actions. Deleting a category just un-categorises things; nothing else is removed.

New block

⚡ Quick add

Type it the way you'd say it, e.g. “call Sam Friday 3pm” or “timecards every other Friday”. Start with note: to make a note instead, or risk:, issue: or decision: for the RAID log.

⌨ Keyboard shortcuts & tips

Press ? any time to open this. Shortcuts that are single keys work when you're not typing in a box.
